Work History

XVIII

Role
Art Direction
Organization
Eighteen Visions
Platforms
Vinyl LP

XVIII is a personal visual project built around image, atmosphere, and a sequence of collected moments.

The work uses repetition and variation to explore how a single idea can shift across a small set of related images.

Building a visual sequence

Each image holds its own frame while sharing the same visual language, allowing the sequence to feel connected without becoming repetitive.

Small changes in crop, color, and detail create movement from one image to the next.

An open-ended study

XVIII is intentionally open-ended: a place to test a mood, keep a visual thread alive, and let the final form emerge through making.

The project stays close to process, treating each image as both a finished artifact and a prompt for the next one.

A personal practice

XVIII is an ongoing space for experimenting with image, texture, and visual memory.

It keeps the work close to the things that make personal projects rewarding: looking closely, making connections, and letting the details stay visible.
